classification.difficultyReason: Follow the named cosine-angle, triangular area and prism-volume sequence.

content.prompt: A triangular prism has base edge of 8 cm, 10 cm, and 15 cm, and a height of 20 cm.

spec.description: Source perspective arrangement: upper face PQR, lower face STU, corresponding vertical edges PS, QT and RU; hidden ST dashed. Blue edges and angle arc, black labels. Diagram is not to scale.
spec.mathematics: PQ=15 cm, PR=8 cm, QR=10 cm, PS=20 cm; theta marks angle PRQ.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Calculate the size of $\angle PRQ$, correct to the nearest degree.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the area of $\Delta PQR$, correct to the nearest cm$^2$.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the volume of the prism.
